title: Refactor Cli Output Templates
description: Refactor all outputs to use templates for rendering (markdown and text). Use go embed for templates.
summary: Refactored all CLI rendering outputs to use Go embed templates (text.tpl and markdown.tpl). Converted renderEntityHuman, renderEntityMarkdownLink, renderEntityMarkdown, HumanRenderer.Render, formatResult, MarkdownRenderer.Render, formatMarkdownResult, renderEventsToMarkdown, renderTreeNodeMarkdown, and renderPromptTemplate to use template-based rendering. Fixed pre-existing commit-to-checkpoint rename in tests. Updated fixture file URIs from old composerepo://file/ and composerepo://section/ formats to new structured composerepo://p/u/.../b/a/.../f/... format. All tests pass.
